faq_heading: Sunnyside Park houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Sunnyside Park. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Sunnyside Park, South Surrey and White Rock: 44 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 11 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 25%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 7 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Sunnyside Park fell from 50 in June to 44 in October (−12.0%), and 29 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 7.7% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 570 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Sunnyside Park?
Sunnyside Park also had 22 condos and townhomes listed and 8 sold in October, against 44 houses listed. The Sunnyside Park condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Sunnyside Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

50 houses sold in Sunnyside Park with a median price of $1,434,500 (the middle half sold between $1,284,500 and $1,659,000), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 94.4% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $646 per square foot, a median year built of 1984 and a median lot of 7,236 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 44 houses listed in Sunnyside Park. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sunnyside Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Sunnyside Park had a sales ratio of 25%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Sunnyside Park from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 29 houses sold in Sunnyside Park over those 5 months, out of 294 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Sunnyside Park sell for?
faq.a: 50 houses sold in Sunnyside Park between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,434,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Sunnyside Park?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.4% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
